title: DAW's settings for one project: .daw/config.yml
description: Committed in the project and read by daw/scripts/daw_config.py, the one reader. A project without the file keeps today's flow, exactly as if it said `spec-format: daw`. Written by /daw-init (daw/scripts/daw_init.py).

version.description: The format of this file. Only 1 exists.

spec-format.description: How a ticket's spec is written. `daw`: the spec carries the what and the how, as it always has. `openspec`: the spec names one `openspec/changes/<name>`, writes only the how (blocks, tests, order, gates), and its receipt seals that change too.
